title: A spatio-temporal fingerprints with hierarchical activation refinement for predicting task activation maps from resting-state fMRI

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A spatio-temporal fingerprints with hierarchical activation refinement for predicting task activation maps from resting-state fMRI》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Predicting task-induced brain activation maps from resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is an important challenge in computational neuroimaging, with potential applications for studying brain function without task-based scanning.
